#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

struct IntStack {
    vector<int> array;
    int size = 0;
    IntStack() : array(8) {}
    IntStack(int capacity) : array(capacity) {}
    void push(int item) {
        if (size >= (int)array.size()) {
            array.resize(array.size() << 1);
        }
        array[size++] = item;
    }
    int get(int i) const {
        assert(i < size);
        return array[i];
    }
    int getSize() const { return size; }
};

struct NumberTheory {
    struct Modulus {
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;
        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }
        virtual ll modulus() const = 0;
        ll fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.getSize() <= n) {
                factorial.push((int)mult(factorial.get(factorial.getSize() - 1), factorial.getSize()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }
        ll fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.getSize() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                int len = n - lastKnown;
                vector<ll> fInvVec(len);
                fInvVec[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < len; ++i) {
                    fInvVec[i] = mult(fInvVec[i-1], (ll)(n - i + 1));
                }
                for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInvVec[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }
        ll ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }
        ll smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }
        ll normalize(ll x) const {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }
        ll add(ll a, ll b) const {
            ll v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }
        ll subtract(ll a, ll b) const {
            ll v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + modulus() : v;
        }
        ll mult(ll a, ll b) const {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }
        ll mult(ll a, ll b, ll c) const {
            return mult(mult(a, b), c);
        }
        ll inv(ll value) {
            ll g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (ll r = value; r != 0; ) {
                ll q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                swap(g, r);
                ll temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp - q * y;
            }
            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };
    struct Mod998 : public Modulus {
        ll modulus() const override { return 998244353LL; }
    };
};

struct InputReader {
    BufferedReader reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;
    InputReader() : reader() {}
    InputReader(istream& is) : reader(is) {}
    string next() {
        while (!tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(reader, line)) break;
            tokenizer = StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

struct BufferedReader {
    istream& is;
    BufferedReader(istream& is) : is(is) {}
    bool getline(string& s) {
        return static_cast<bool>(std::getline(is, s));
    }
};

struct StringTokenizer {
    vector<string> tokens;
    int idx;
    StringTokenizer() : idx(0) {}
    StringTokenizer(const string& s) {
        stringstream ss(s);
        string token;
        while (ss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
        idx = 0;
    }
    bool hasMoreTokens() const { return idx < (int)tokens.size(); }
    string nextToken() { return tokens[idx++]; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    mod.fInv(n + m);

    ll phaseSize = 1;
    ll p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    ll answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        ll numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        ll e = mod.mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
        ll term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), e);

        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
